name: Veyron Proyect
description: Frame-based macro recording and playback with a polished control panel, compact configurable gameplay HUD, native VPR import/export, and input timing analysis.

hud-enabled.name: Enable gameplay HUD
hud-enabled.description: Show the Veyron live status panel while playing.

hud-position.name: HUD position
hud-position.description: Choose one of the four screen corners.

hud-scale.name: HUD scale
hud-scale.description: Size of the live status panel.

audio-enabled.name: Enable chimes
audio-enabled.description: Play a short tone on captured and replayed press inputs. The pitch follows the interval between presses, not a measured hitbox window.

master-volume.name: Chime volume
master-volume.description: Amplitude of generated Veyron WAV chimes.

safe-mode.name: Safe playback mode
safe-mode.description: Require Practice Mode before injecting a macro into gameplay.

auto-save.name: Auto-save on stop/reset/quit
auto-save.description: Write the captured macro to the configured VPR path when a recording ends.

macro-file.name: VPR macro file
macro-file.description: The same path is used by the Load VPR and Save VPR buttons.

hud-opacity.name: HUD opacity
hud-opacity.description: Background opacity of the in-game Veyron HUD.

hud-refresh-interval.name: HUD refresh interval
hud-refresh-interval.description: How often the HUD text is refreshed. Lower values update more frequently.

hud-show-frame.name: Show simulation frame
hud-show-frame.description: Show the simulation tick counter on the HUD.

hud-show-inputs.name: Show input count
hud-show-inputs.description: Show the number of recorded macro events on the HUD.

hud-show-cps.name: Show approximate CPS
hud-show-cps.description: Show the approximate number of presses over the rolling one-second tick window.

hud-show-last-action.name: Show last action
hud-show-last-action.description: Show the latest Veyron status message on the HUD.

hud-show-safe-mode.name: Show Safe Mode badge
hud-show-safe-mode.description: Show SAFE in the HUD header when Practice Mode protection is enabled.
